authors.description: the authors as one line of text, as the page writes them and without the year (for example `Vaswani et al.`). It is a citation line, not a list of names: a `feed-item` lists each author in `fields.authors`, and the two are not the same shape

url.description: where to read the paper; an arXiv abstract page (`https://arxiv.org/abs/<arXiv ID>`) when there is one, otherwise the publisher, a PDF or a book page. A paper's arXiv ID is not stored: it is the part of an arXiv abstract address after `/abs/`

topics.description: FKs → research-topic/<slug>: every topic the paper is listed under; empty when it belongs to none

must_read.description: present only for the papers on the must-read list

era.description: the era heading the paper sits under, newest era first

order.description: position in the must-read list, 1 = first

is_high_impact.description: one of the few papers the page highlights beside the lists

summary.description: the short must-read text, kept when a longer text fills the `Why It Matters` section

citation_signals.description: agent-owned: citation figures copied from OpenAlex by code for a paper whose `url` is an arXiv abstract page or a DOI address; absent until the first read

cited_by_count.description: how many works cite the paper

venue.description: the source OpenAlex names for the paper's primary location (a journal, a repository); absent when it names none

observed_at.description: the day these figures were read; refreshed only when a figure changed

source.description: the paper's OpenAlex address, for example https://openalex.org/W2626778328
